methods.difference: Newcombe unpaired score interval; 95% pointwise, not multiplicity adjusted
methods.test: Two-sided pooled two-proportion z test, equivalent to Pearson chi-square without continuity correction
methods.multiplicity: Holm correction over all 150 pairwise tests (30 baseline + 120 same-return-date)
methods.interpretation: Exploratory user-level association in this historical extract; conditional returner comparisons are not causal
methods.p_underflow: Numeric p may underflow to zero. Use log10_p fields and labels for extremely small p-values.
